# RuneSoft — official port product page

- Original source: [RuneSoft — official port product page](https://www.rune-soft.com/Games/Released/Game-239/game=Robin_Hood_The_Legend_of_Sherwood-13)
- Author / publication: RuneSoft
- Language / date: English; page lists release 2005-11-24
- Access: Page text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

An official product page for the Linux and Mac ports. It names Spellbound Entertainment as the original developer and lists German, English, and French.

The advertised features include more than thirty missions, five castles visited under different lighting and weather, nine character types, and mouse-controlled sword fighting. The page includes an OS X Lion patch link.

**Dating caution:** the displayed release date is 24 November 2005, while its Mac requirements mention OS X 10.6.6 and an Intel processor. Those fields reflect different stages of the product's history and cannot establish a single original release configuration. Other databases give different port dates.

**Research use:** first-party evidence of the ports, supported languages as advertised on this page, and later Mac maintenance.
